title: Require secure connections
description: Upgrade ordinary browsing to HTTPS. HTTP-only sites need an explicit exception.
warning: Turning this off permits unencrypted HTTP connections.

title: Require HTTPS in private windows
description: Use HTTPS-only protection in private windows too.
warning: Turning this off permits unencrypted HTTP connections in private windows.

title: Block known trackers
description: Use Firefox tracking-protection lists. Use the shield button for site exceptions.
warning: Turning this off reduces tracking protection.

title: Block social-media trackers
description: Reduce cross-site tracking from embedded social content.

title: Block cryptomining scripts
description: Block known scripts that consume resources to mine cryptocurrency.

title: Block known fingerprinters
description: Block listed fingerprinting scripts while retaining ordinary website features.

title: Resist fingerprinting
description: Normalize browser characteristics. This can alter time zones, appearance, and site behavior.
warning: Fingerprinting resistance can break website features and change how pages look.

title: Cookies in ordinary windows
description: Partitioning cross-site cookies balances privacy with website compatibility.
warning: Changing cookie isolation can reduce privacy or break sign-in and embedded content.

title: Cookies in private windows
description: Partitioning cross-site cookies balances privacy with website compatibility.
warning: Changing cookie isolation can reduce privacy or break sign-in and embedded content.

title: Enable browsing containers
description: Keep cookies separate between container identities. Existing tabs are not automatically moved.

title: Show container controls
description: Expose upstream controls for opening tabs in separate containers.

title: Location requests
description: Choose whether websites may ask for this permission. Existing site exceptions are managed in Privacy & Security.

options.label: Ask each time permission is needed

title: Camera requests
description: Choose whether websites may ask for this permission. Existing site exceptions are managed in Privacy & Security.

options.label: Ask each time permission is needed

title: Microphone requests
description: Choose whether websites may ask for this permission. Existing site exceptions are managed in Privacy & Security.

options.label: Ask each time permission is needed

title: Notification requests
description: Choose whether websites may ask for this permission. Existing site exceptions are managed in Privacy & Security.

options.label: Ask each time permission is needed

title: Remote search suggestions
description: Send typed search text to the selected search engine for suggestions.
warning: Enabling remote suggestions can send partial search queries to your search provider.

title: Suggestions in private windows
description: Allow the search engine to receive partial queries from private windows.
warning: Enabling remote suggestions can send partial search queries to your search provider.

title: Search suggestions in the address bar
description: Include search-engine suggestions in address-bar results.
warning: Enabling remote suggestions can send partial search queries to your search provider.

title: Suggest browsing history
description: Find previously visited pages from the address bar.

title: Suggest bookmarks
description: Include saved bookmarks in address-bar results.

title: Suggest open tabs
description: Find and switch to tabs already open in this profile.

title: Suggest search engines
description: Offer installed search engines in address-bar results.

title: Complete addresses inline
description: Complete known addresses from local browsing data.

title: Confirm closing multiple tabs
description: Ask before closing a window with multiple tabs.

title: Confirm closing other tabs
description: Ask before closing other tabs from a tab menu.

title: Warn before opening many tabs
description: Confirm opening a large group of tabs at once.

title: Open links in background tabs
description: Keep the current tab selected when opening a link in a new tab.

title: Keep related tabs together
description: Open related tabs next to the current tab.

title: Close the window with its last tab
description: When disabled, closing the last tab keeps the browser window available.

title: Preview tabs on hover
description: Show a preview when the pointer rests on a tab.

title: Show images in tab previews
description: Include a page thumbnail in the preview.

title: Switch tabs by recent use
description: Use Ctrl+Tab to switch through recently used tabs.

title: Enable tab groups
description: Organize related tabs into collapsible groups.

title: Use vertical tabs
description: Place the tab list in the side panel instead of along the top.

title: Toolbar density
description: Choose compact, standard, or touch-friendly spacing.

title: Bookmarks toolbar
description: Choose where the bookmarks toolbar appears.

title: Website fonts
description: Use website fonts or prefer your configured fonts. Font substitution can change layout.

title: Website color preference
description: Choose the light/dark preference advertised to websites. Sites may use their own theme.

title: When the browser starts
description: Choose a blank page, your homepage, or the previous session.

title: Smooth scrolling
description: Animate scrolling instead of moving in immediate steps.

title: Middle-button autoscroll
description: Use the middle mouse button to scroll.

title: Find text as you type
description: Start a page search when typing outside a text field.

title: Warn about automatic refresh
description: Allow upstream warnings for pages that automatically reload or redirect.

title: Use keyboard media keys
description: Let hardware media keys control browser playback.

title: Remember zoom for each website
description: Store a separate zoom level for each site.

title: Zoom the whole page
description: Scale layout and images as well as text.

title: Navigate text with a caret
description: Use a movable text cursor for keyboard selection. This changes normal arrow-key behavior.
warning: Caret browsing changes keyboard navigation on websites.

title: Spell checking
description: Choose which editable text fields receive spelling checks.

title: Autoplay
description: Control autoplay. Websites with explicit permission can behave differently.

title: Picture-in-picture
description: Watch supported video in a floating window.

title: Show picture-in-picture button
description: Display the floating video button on supported videos.

title: Allow real-time calls
description: Enable WebRTC for voice/video calls and other real-time connections.
warning: Disabling WebRTC breaks many voice/video calling services.

title: Save to the default download folder
description: When disabled, ask where to save downloaded files.

title: Open the downloads panel automatically
description: Show download progress when a new download starts.

title: Add downloads to Windows recent files
description: Allow downloaded items to appear in the operating system recent-document history.

title: Unload tabs when memory is low
description: Allow the browser to unload inactive tabs under memory pressure. Returning to a tab may reload it.

title: Avoid speculative DNS requests
description: Resolve names when needed rather than speculating ahead. This may increase initial navigation latency.
